title: k = 0: equal running sums
notes: With k = 0 a subarray sums to 0 exactly when its two ends have the same running sum. Here the running sum is 0 four times (at the start and after 2, 4 and 6 values): 4 choose 2 = 6 subarrays. Look up before recording: the other way round, each value would also count itself as an empty subarray, 12 in all.
